statement: Under these hypotheses: (1) The extended Hodge filtration is by subbundles of V . For a morphism g : (T′, D′) → (T, D) of smooth projective varieties with reduced simple normal crossings boundaries and g(T′ \ D′) ⊂ U, the extended Hodge line of g∗V is g∗J. These extensions commute with direct sums and tensor products. If the monodromy logarithms of some boundary components vanish, the variation extends purely across those components, including their crossings away from the remaining boundary. (2) The line J is nef. It is big precisely when the top Kodaira–Spencer map TU −→ Hom(Fm VO, Fm−1 VO/Fm VO) is generically injective, equivalently when ℓ is generically immersive. The first assertions are the unipotent extension and nilpotent-orbit theorems of [25, 11]; functo- riality is also recorded in [5, Lemmas 2.16 and 5.6]. The second assertion is [4, Lemma 6.17].
